[SWS_DM_01747] S3 timer value
⌈
If the parameter DiagnosticSession-
ControlClass.s3ServerTimeout is not configured, the Diagnostic Server
instance (Software Cluster), shall take the value of 5000ms as the S3Server time-
out. If the parameter DiagnosticSessionControlClass.s3ServerTimeout is
configured, the Diagnostic Server Instance (Software Cluster) shall take the configured
value as the S3Server timeout.
⌋
